title: scythe cutlist
description: A cutlist is either a segment array (one video track) or a document with tagged tracks. Style, structure and pacing are the author's choice: no phase vocabulary, casing rule, filter vocabulary or adjacency rule is enforced. Cross-field rules (end > start, base-track continuity, asset probing, resolvable filter/effect/transition names) live in src/validator.py because JSON Schema cannot express them.

x.description: Track offset in px from the left edge. Ignored on the base (first) track.

y.description: Track offset in px from the top edge. Ignored on the base (first) track.

scale.description: Track scale against the canvas. 0.3 gives a picture-in-picture layer.

asset.description: Path to the audio file, relative to the project directory.

duration.description: Seconds taken from the source. Defaults to the rest of the timeline.

duck_under.description: Track ids this track is sidechain-compressed against, e.g. a music bed ducking under the voice track.

cleanup.description: Enable denoise and noise gate. Effective only when voice_cleanup is on in the project config.

start.description: Start on the timeline in seconds.

end.description: End on the timeline in seconds. Must be greater than start.

asset.description: Source file relative to the project root. Null generates a solid frame from color.

color.description: Solid frame color for a segment with no asset, as any ffmpeg color name or hex. Defaults to black, or white when filter is white_flash.

clip_end.description: Source out-point in seconds. Defaults to clip_start plus the segment duration times speed.

speed.description: Playback rate. 0.5 is slow motion, 2 is double speed.

scale.description: Extra source scale before the canvas fit.

filter.description: Named filter from the registry, or 'raw:<libavfilter chain>' for anything else. The named set is grayscale, color_invert, color_crush, high_contrast_green, high_contrast_red, chromatic_aberration, film_grain, warm, cool, soft, white_flash.

effect.description: Named motion (ken_burns_slow, ken_burns_fast, snap_zoom, strobe, word_flash) or 'raw:<libavfilter chain>'. Cannot be combined with keyframes.

keyframes.description: Keyframed camera: at is a fraction of the segment, so the cutlist survives a duration change. Overrides effect.

x.description: Pan offset in px from center.

y.description: Pan offset in px from center.

opacity.description: Static opacity. Applies to segments on overlay tracks.

fade_in.description: Seconds. Fades from black on the base track, from transparent on an overlay track.

x.description: Position override in px, added to the track offset.

y.description: Position override in px, added to the track offset.

transition.description: Transition into this segment: an alias (cross_dissolve, dip_to_black, dip_to_white, luma_wipe, slide_left, ...) or any xfade transition name. hard_cut snaps.

transition_duration.description: Seconds. Defaults to the project transition_duration.

text.description: Burned caption. Wording, casing and length are the author's call.

phase.description: Free-form label for your own structure. Not interpreted by the engine.

overlays.description: Alpha layers composited over this segment: logos, textures, grain, PiP frames.
